description: This source file is a Perl script that manipulates binary chunk files, involving reading specific data structures, packing/unpacking 64-bit file offsets, and copying or modifying chunk data based on given parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from STDIN, with error handling.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Reads bytes from STDIN using get() and copies them to STDOUT.

methods.name: unpack_quad
methods.description: Unpacks an 8-byte string into a 64-bit value by extracting and combining two 32-bit unsigned integers, with a check for overflow.

methods.name: pack_quad
methods.description: Packs a 64-bit value into an 8-byte string as two 32-bit unsigned integers, verifying the integrity of the round-trip conversion.
